title: Jordan Tour Package - 4 days
highlights: Discover Petra, the rose-red Lost City and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.
Experience Wadi Rum’s Martian-like desert on a 4x4 Jeep safari.
Float in the mineral-rich waters of the Dead Sea and enjoy a rejuvenating mud bath.
Enjoy 3 nights in a handpicked hotel or resort.
Learn about Jordan’s history and culture from expert guides.
overview: Enjoy a mesmerizing journey through Jordan, a land of ancient wonders and breathtaking landscapes. This three-night, four-day tour takes you to Petra, the rose-red city, the Martian-like Wadi Rum desert and the therapeutic waters of the Dead Sea. With seamless transfers, guided tours and comfortable accommodation, this package combines history, adventure and relaxation.

sections.title: History, Adventure and Relaxation in Jordan
paragraphs: Explore iconic landmarks from the ancient city of Petra to Wadi Rum’s surreal desert and the therapeutic waters of the Dead Sea.
Enjoy a carefully planned Jordan experience with private transfers, guided sightseeing and comfortable stays.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman – Transfer to Petra
description: Arrive at Queen Alia International Airport in Amman and meet our representative.
Enjoy a scenic three-hour transfer to Petra, the rose-red city.
Check in to your Petra hotel and relax overnight.

itinerary.title: Explore Petra – Transfer to Wadi Rum
itinerary.description: Explore the Lost City of Petra with a guided tour before continuing to Wadi Rum for a desert experience and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Wadi Rum – Dead Sea
itinerary.description: Enjoy a Wadi Rum 4x4 Jeep safari before travelling to the Dead Sea. Float in the mineral-rich waters and experience the famous mud bath.

itinerary.title: Dead Sea – Departure
itinerary.description: Complete your Jordan journey and transfer for departure.

included: 3 nights’ accommodation in a hotel or resort.
Guided tours in Petra and Wadi Rum.
excluded: Optional activities such as hot-air balloons and spa treatments.
Additional activities not mentioned in the itinerary.
goodToKnow: Jordan has hot days and cool nights; pack light clothes and a jacket.
The currency is the Jordanian Dinar (JOD); carry cash.
Arabic is the main language and English is widely spoken.
Drink bottled water, use sunscreen and wear comfortable shoes.
